scope_note: Raw Internet Archive capture of 5 April 2023 of Légifrance's Journal officiel text page (the /jorf/id/ address; NOR HRUX9110104D); Légifrance itself refuses automated access (HTTP 403 on 29 September 2026), which was not bypassed. The reference line is printed as Légifrance prints it. The page renders no decree text; the scanned paper issue behind its 'Télécharger' button is a script-driven secure download and was not fetched.

rows.text: Légifrance's page for the 'Décret du 15 mai 1991 PORTANT NOMINATION DU PREMIER MINISTRE' (JORF n°113 du 16 mai 1991, NOR HRUX9110104D) renders the title and reference block but no text: under 'Version initiale' it offers only the scanned paper issue ('version papier numérisée'); the appointee is not named on the page.

bounded_scope: Head-of-government observations for CLAUDE-C01-37 only (Premier ministre, 1 January 1990 to the 7 September 2026 cutoff; this batch covers the first ten people to hold the office in the period). The Prime Minister's letter presenting the Government's resignation, the decree ending the Government's functions, the decree appointing a Prime Minister, a decree countersigned or signed by the Prime Minister and a later decree's reference to an appointment stay separate rows; holder boundaries are decided in the packet, not by any row. The Président de la République, ministers, party offices and continued handling of current affairs are excluded.
